NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author pushed one new commit with a reworded subject, "drafts: Preserve focus on draft action controls.", which fixes the style problem karlstolley raised. The code and the PR description are unchanged.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | The commit subject now follows Zulip style (area prefix, capitalized, ends with a period). |
| ✅  | The screencast is in the main PR description, as laurynmm asked. I can't tell from the input whether it shows the keys pressed. |
| ❌  | The description says `Fixes: issue-#39005` instead of `Fixes: #39005`, so GitHub shows no linked issue and "help wanted" can't be checked. The author has no merged PRs. |
| ℹ️  | Open PR #39959 ("message overlays: Enable keyboard navigation for row action buttons") may overlap with this one. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" until the `Fixes:` line is corrected and the linked issue is confirmed to have "help wanted". After that, remove "not ready", add "maintainer review", and assign laurynmm, who has been reviewing.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for updating the commit message, that looks much better now. Could you change `Fixes: issue-#39005` in the PR description to `Fixes: #39005` so the issue gets linked properly? Then we can move this on to review.
```
